claims.statement: Tom Allen was staying at the Buckeye House in Cincinnati, where crowds came to see him.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen had another big crowd down to see him at

claims.statement: Tom Allen had a row with Sherman Thurston at the Buckeye House in Cincinnati; the Enquirer says it was settled with a drink and a handshake.
claims.excerpt: between Tom Allen and Sherman Thersten

claims.statement: Tom Allen's fight with Mike McCoole was set for 10 November 1869.

quotes.speaker: Cincinnati Commercial
quotes.text: losing sight apparently of his duty on the 10th, with McCoole, allowed himself to have a personal controversy
quotes.topic: criticism of Allen over the Thurston row

fights.notes: Scheduled; not yet fought at this date.

notes: The Commercial says the row came very near a fight outside Allen's sleeping room; the Enquirer says it was settled. The 31 Oct date rests on 'yesterday' in the Monday Enquirer; medium confidence on the row's date.
